nodes.description: address public owner; privileged account set in constructor
uint public id; monotonically increasing record counter used as key into user_details
mapping(uint=>Bank) public user_details; stores per-id bank records (user, amount, rate, cycle, intrest, state)
mapping(uint=>uint) rate; asset-type index to interest rate, writable only by owner
constructor(): sets owner = msg.sender and id = 1, emits deployed
setUser(uint,uint,BankAsssetType,uint) public: creates a bank record for msg.sender with the current global id and increments id
setRate(uint,uint,uint,uint,uint,uint) onlyOwner public: writes the six asset rates and emits rates
withdraw(uint,BankAsssetType) onlyOwner public: computes intrest, marks record mature and records withdrawal asset/state
cal_intrest(uint) onlyOwner public: recomputes and stores intrest for a given record id
modifier onlyOwner: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control guard applied to setRate, withdraw and cal_intrest
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and as stored record owner
unchecked arithmetic in withdraw: _rate*user_details[_id].cycle*user_details[_id].amount/(100*12) can overflow/underflow (Solidity <0.8)
unchecked arithmetic in cal_intrest: _rate*user_details[_id].cycle*user_details[_id].amount/(100*12) can overflow/underflow (Solidity <0.8)
require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check evaluated on caller-supplied address with no revert message
parameter _cycle in setUser (interest cycle in months, required >= 1)
parameter _asset_value_USD in setUser (required >= 100)
parameter _v_asset (BankAsssetType) in setUser, used as rate lookup key
parameter _amount in setUser, principal stored in the bank record
parameter agcoin_rate in setRate written to rate[AGCoin]
parameter eth_rate in setRate written to rate[ETH]
parameter btc_rate in setRate written to rate[BTC]
parameter ltc_rate in setRate written to rate[LTC]
parameter xrp_rate in setRate written to rate[XRP]
parameter usd_rate in setRate written to rate[USD]
parameter _id in withdraw, index into user_details
parameter withdrawAsset (BankAsssetType) in withdraw, stored as the withdrawal asset
parameter _id in cal_intrest, index into user_details
local _rate in setUser = rate[uint(_v_asset)], copied into the record
local _rate in withdraw = user_details[_id].rate, multiplied in the interest formula
local _rate in cal_intrest = user_details[_id].rate, multiplied in the interest formula
